measurement_notes: Timing is local monotonic wall time including process launch and up to 5 ms wait polling; CPU time is recorded separately per case
Resident bytes in detailed receipts are wait4 child-lifetime ru_maxrss, including inherited/pre-exec Python launcher memory; they are not an isolated candidate-only RSS measurement
RSS is per individual child process, not a cumulative peak over prior children. No OJ memory, time-limit pass, or speed-ranking claim is made
